notes.subject: Aug. 28 — signed contract returned; booking confirmed
notes.body: CONFIRMED BOOKING: Discover Meeteetse returned the signed contract on Aug. 28, 2026. The contract page identifies Dave Gordon and Codi-Brooke Robinson and is dated Aug. 27, 2026. Codi-Brooke's email also states she is thrilled to have The Adventure Zone in Meeteetse and that she started distributing the flyer. Event dates are Sept. 5-7, 2026. Commercial structure is pay-for-play with no upfront entertainment fee to the event; Adventure Zone sets/collects public admission and pays the sponsoring event 10% of ticket-box sales within 24 hours after the final operating day. Current attraction commitment is 8-10 inflatables. Adventure Zone is the exclusive commercial inflatable attraction, amusement ride, and pay-to-play carnival game operator at the approved site. Event-side requirements include permission to arrive Sept. 3 and remain through Sept. 8 at midnight; (4) 220V 50-amp outlets or 24 separate 110V outlets within 150 feet, or a 50 kW generator; water within 150 feet; camping or suitable lodging; 24-hour restroom access; local/state permits and inspection costs; and a forklift/operator for reload if available. Remaining operations items are final setup location/footprint, operating hours, final attraction/site layout, and final electrical plan. COI was requested Aug. 28.
